title: Overcoming Configuration Bottleneck: Modular Pathways to Stable Semiconductor Spin-Qubit Arrays
summary: Over the past decade, semiconductor spin qubits have progressed from few-qubit demonstrations towards larger-scale devices fabricated in increasingly reproducible academic and industrial processes. This progress marks an inflection point: the central challenge is no longer to demonstrate high-fidelity operation in carefully tuned devices, but to discover, verify, and maintain stable operating conditions reliably across many interdependent controls, varied device geometries, and disparate material platforms. In this Perspective, we frame spin-qubit operation as a modular automation problem.…
